tasks.label: Run a periodic manager review
tasks.description: Follow the work from preparation and manager decisions to verified removals and closure.

tasks.label: Review access to one application
tasks.description: Follow a review of production accounts, including who reviews the source owner's own access.

tasks.label: Review everyone holding particular access
tasks.description: Work through a targeted export review across reporting and archive accounts.

groups.title: Help reviewers finish the right work

tasks.label: Check campaign progress
tasks.description: See what each count means and which reviews still need work.

tasks.label: Follow up as the deadline approaches
tasks.description: Check pending work, reminders and the reason a reviewer has not finished.

tasks.label: Find why the reviewer or person is wrong
tasks.description: Check which person owns the account and who received the review.

tasks.label: Handle a reviewer who is away or has left
tasks.description: Check existing work and arrange suitable review responsibility.

tasks.label: Investigate missing or unexpected access
tasks.description: Check the collected access, selected people, access profiles and roles, and the review that was created.

tasks.label: Explain an unclear permission
tasks.description: Find out what the permission lets the account do before judging whether it is needed.

tasks.label: Check whether saved decisions are final
tasks.description: Separate recorded item choices from the reviewer's final confirmation.

groups.title: Follow removals and close the review

tasks.label: Check what removal work is required
tasks.description: Find which access must be removed and how the change can be carried out.

tasks.label: Follow a manual access-removal task
tasks.description: Connect the assigned work to the actual application change and its evidence.

tasks.label: Investigate failed removal or remaining access
tasks.description: Find whether the change failed, another assignment remains, or the evidence is out of date.

tasks.label: Verify that the intended access was removed
tasks.description: Check the correct application account, retained access and updated ISC information.

tasks.label: Choose the right reports and evidence
tasks.description: Match configuration, decisions, sign-off and removal evidence to the question.

tasks.label: Handle overdue and unfinished reviews
tasks.description: Check the actual review state and supported handling of undecided access.

tasks.label: Review uncorrelated-account access
tasks.description: Assess the account's current purpose and permissions while treating ownership repair separately.

tasks.label: Review a program or service account
tasks.description: Follow the review of a program's account and check that its approved work can continue.

tasks.label: Review what a shared role contains
tasks.description: Follow a decision about a role's contents through the correction and resulting account changes.
